description: Confirm a newly registered account with the 6-digit code from the verification email sent by safe_mind_register. No API key needed. Returns a confirmation message; afterwards call safe_mind_get_api_key. A wrong or expired code returns an error without revealing whether the account exists.

code.description: The 6-digit verification code from the email, e.g. "123456".

email.description: The email address used in safe_mind_register.

name: safe_mind_verify_email
